title: The Handover
place: Civic Records Office, the civic block
note: Fable, 2026-10-23, third pass: the file is the motive (Sky); Vale carries it out of the Office at shift change and delivers it to Security tonight, so the take lands before the hand-off. variants.A/B/C each complete; the screen reads variants[pick]. A.hook: Vale has a file on you. Tonight he carries it to Security.
handler: The cameras caught your cell. Councillor Vale put it on paper.
No networks here. The file lives in a folder and in his head.
Reach him first. Then we learn who else has read it.

dossier.objective: Take him alive. Deliver him to the getaway car.

intel: Inez, café waitress. She knows the door guard.
